title: Iterator Pattern
overview: Provide a way to sequentially access elements of a collection without exposing its underlying representation.
useCases: You want to traverse a collection without exposing its internal representation
You want different ways to traverse the same collection (forward, reverse, filtered, etc.)
You want all collections to provide a consistent way to iterate
exampleUses: A social media feed iterator that abstracts away pagination and API calls, letting the caller loop over posts with a simple hasNext()/next() loop
A tree iterator that exposes a depth-first or breadth-first traversal without the caller needing to manage a stack or queue
A lazy file-line iterator that reads lines from a large log file one at a time without loading the whole file into memory
